title: Banana and Peanut Butter Pandesal

title: Tofu Sisig Silog
blurb: Crisp tofu with calamansi, onion and an egg over garlic rice.

steps.text: Pat the tofu dry and cut into small cubes. Chop the onion, garlic and chili. Mix strained calamansi juice, soy sauce and mayonnaise.
Brown the tofu in half the oil over medium heat, turning to crisp several sides. Take the pan off the heat, toss the tofu with the sauce, onion and chili, and transfer it to a plate.
Heat the rest of the oil and briefly sauté the garlic until fragrant. Add cooked rice and stir to heat through. If using chilled leftover rice, heat it to 74°C.
Clear a spot for the egg, or use the empty pan after plating the rice. Fry the egg until the white and yolk are firm, then serve alongside the tofu.

tip: Use a mayonnaise and soy sauce with allergen labels you can check.

title: Tuyo and Tomato Silog

Fry the egg in the same pan until the white and yolk are firm. Serve with the rice, tuyo and fresh tomato, checking for bones as you eat.

title: Tocino Silog
